posts.author: MichaelH
posts.content_md:
I ran across this old picture this weekend.

![Image](http://www.dragonseye.com/gallery/d/5938-4/OldHoloTable.jpg)

It's my table from around '91.

It consisted of a rickety wooden table with plywood on top, a layer of sorbothane balls and another layer of plywood. The bases were all gravity bases. I actually used it to make pretty decent masters and my first white light transfers (reflection and rainbow).
